# Roboto

Variable font bundled locally from the official Google Fonts repository:

- Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/roboto
- Original filename: `Roboto[wdth,wght].ttf`
- Download: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/roboto/Roboto%5Bwdth,wght%5D.ttf
- SHA-256: `d7598e12c5dbef095ff8272cfc55da0250bd07fbdecbac8a530b9b277872a134`
- License: SIL Open Font License, included as `OFL.txt`.

The bundled file is a fixed snapshot; runtime does not fetch Google Fonts.
